tools.name: search_shop_policies_and_faqs
tools.description:
Used to get facts about the stores policies, products, or services.
Some examples of questions you can ask are:
  - What is your return policy?
  - What is your shipping policy?
  - What is your phone number?
  - What are your hours of operation?"
Set policy_types to also get the store's written pol

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_shop_policies_and_faqs" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
